story_text.value: Hi HN! I've been building Auro, my little package manager, for about 5 months now and consider it ready for release. Auro is my replacement for curl | bash commands, as it makes it extremely easy to package binaries for it. Repositories can take up little space, and can even be hosted on GitHub Pages! I would love for some people to try and give feedback.

story_text.value: This is demo of my prototype which performs searches over YaCy P2P network and tries to do it fast and provide more relevant results especially for multi-word queries. Built it because found quality of search results provided by the reference Java implementation to be poor. Would be like to hear your feedback about it.
